Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a documentation-only pull request.
The unmet item is: “Every Forge pull request check runs the cheap whole-repo rule tests (tests/test_platform_sensitive_selection.py, tests/test_tools_guide.py synced-guides test, tests/test_rules.py rule and size checks) on top of the selected tests, adding under a minute”. The required tests are added only after pytest_tests starts. However, .github/workflows/forge.yml:43 skips the test jobs for documentation-only changes, and lines 97–99 explicitly accept that skip. The command also retains its earlier bypass at src/forge/review.py:403–405. Consequently, these pull requests run none of the required checks. Run the required checks on this path while retaining the skip for unrelated tests.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - running the new proof test in pull request CI.
Both --change cases leave the product change uncommitted after setting origin/main to HEAD. CI supplies FORGE_GROUPS (.github/workflows/forge.yml:53), which the fixture does not clear. With that variable present, fasttest.py:330–332 calls test_run with always=False. Its documentation classifier compares committed base...HEAD (docskip.py:88), sees an empty diff, and skips execution at review.py:403–405. The command returns zero but creates no receipts, so line 53 fails. Commit the product change before invoking --change so this proof exercises the actual CI path.
